name: Xiaomi MiTV-ANSP0 (小米电视5 Pro 65", jobs, Amlogic), China firmware 23.6.5.3226, 4 GB RAM
warnings: Stock launcher: com.mitv.tvhome (PatchWall, HOME activity .MainActivityUserMode) - KEEP IT ENABLED, see "Home" below.

Notes from this firmware: - Home: disabling com.mitv.tvhome drops HOME to com.android.tv.settings/.system.FallbackHome (priority -1000 in the manifest, but it still wins once nothing else is left), which shows a black screen.
Keeping PatchWall enabled and setting the new launcher as the preferred home works, and survives a reboot; PatchWall is then never shown.
